evidence_and_pass_fail.evidence: TAP output of the named command, captured per run with candidate revision; author receipts are diagnostic-only; assurance receipts come from a fresh Assurance Test Engineer session rerunning the same commands
evidence_and_pass_fail.pass_fail: PASS iff every proof row passes its pass_fail_rule on the exact candidate; a typed gap (missing tool, not_run, unavailable backend) is never PASS; NOT_APPLICABLE counts only with a non-empty reason in gate_declarations
evidence_and_pass_fail.tdd: each row with tdd.red_expected=true needs a red run on the Test Implementer candidate and a green run on the Product Implementer candidate over the same test ids (AC-143.07 receipt shape); rows with red_expected=false are regression guards that must stay green throughout

anomaly_corrective_closure.anomaly: typed finding with file:line; advisory otherwise
anomaly_corrective_closure.corrective: one aggregated repair per budget, then deterministic closure without rereview

gate_declarations.source: DEC-AGR-010 per-plan declaration for this Lifecycle

build.reason: No build step: hooks are CommonJS and tests ESM, loaded directly by node; module load failures surface as CMD-TEST-ALL failures.

types_lint.reason: Repository has no type checker or linter and no dependencies; adding one is a new dependency (RISK-001). Whitespace hygiene (CMD-DIFFCHECK, CMD-WRITESET) still runs as a required command but is not claimed as types/lint.

red_then_green.threshold: every test id tagged with a red-expected SEIT row fails with an assertion at the Test Implementer candidate and passes at the Product Implementer candidate; red-expected ids = green ids
red_then_green.receipt: per AC-143.07: failing run on the test-only candidate plus passing run on the product candidate, same test ids

mutation.reason: bearing-lite has no mutation-testing tool: package.json declares no dependencies or devDependencies and the repo ships no mutation script. Adding one is a new dependency requiring maintainer approval (RISK-001) and no slice write set owns it.

changed_line_coverage.reason: No changed-line coverage tool exists in the repository. The node runtime's built-in experimental test coverage reports whole-file line coverage only and has no diff intersection; building one is new tooling outside every slice write set. Not used as a gate or as evidence.

reviewer.reason: phase cadence per profile; consumes the gate-chain receipt per AC-145.01
